principle: Native metadata and MCP metadata are deliberately not losslessly equivalent. Assert each direction against this projection, never against native equality.

selection.note: The nested status command is intentionally outside this projection fixture.

nativeToMcpExport.nameRule: Expand every executable canonical/alias path, replace '-' with '_', lowercase each segment, and join root plus path with '_'. Collisions reject export.

description.base: Use command description, falling back to summary.
description.aliasSuffix: Alias exports identify their canonical command path.
description.constraints: Serialize native constraints into the description; MCP does not receive executable native constraint metadata.
description.streams: If stdin or stdout is declared, document finite buffering with a 16 MiB per-direction limit.

inputSchema.dialect: MCP JSON Schema object without a draft marker
inputSchema.properties: Canonical native input fields in CONTRACT-1 order, including inherited globals and defaults.
inputSchema.requiredness: A field is required only when native omission has no default or implicit value.
inputSchema.collectionBounds: Tail/repeatable min/max bounds become minItems/maxItems; required repeatable maps use minProperties=1.

stdin.textEncoding: UTF-8 string when every declared MIME type starts with text/
stdin.required: Matches the native stdin required bit.

inputSchema.validation: Unknown arguments, JSON/schema mismatch, collection bounds, and native command constraints are rejected before invocation.

outputSchema.recordResult: The record fields are the MCP output object.

successfulResult.structuredContent: Validated native structured result, with non-record values wrapped as {"value": ...}.
contentOrder: structured result rendered as one text block when present

channels.text: A text content block containing valid UTF-8.
channels.image: An image content block with base64 data and the first declared MIME type.
channels.audio: An audio content block with base64 data and the first declared MIME type.
channels.otherBinary: An embedded resource block at golem-tool://<mcp-name>/<channel> with base64 blob data.

successfulResult.streamPolicy: stdin/stdout/stderr are finite buffered byte channels, not live MCP streams; each direction is limited to 16 MiB.

errors.customError: Return MCP isError=true with one text block containing JSON {name,payload}.
errors.invalidInputOrProjection: Return MCP invalid-params protocol error, not a declared native custom error.
errors.transportOrInternalFailure: Return MCP isError content with a diagnostic text block where the invocation layer has a representable failure.

unsupported.case: host-managed capability in canonical input, structured result, or custom-error payload
unsupported.behavior: Reject export and report the capability kind and schema path.

unsupported.case: nested typed stream in canonical input, structured result, or custom-error payload
unsupported.behavior: Reject export recursively; byte stdin/stdout/stderr declarations are the only stream projection.
Unsupported; only finite buffered channels up to 16 MiB are projected.

nativeMetadata.commandTree: Exactly one executable root command named by projectedName, with no aliases, globals, subcommands, positionals, flags, or constraints.
nativeMetadata.doc: Summary is upstream title, falling back to upstream name; description is copied; examples are empty.
nativeMetadata.options: Each projected input property becomes a scalar option with a sanitized native name. Original MCP property names are restored when calling upstream. additionalProperties, when projectable, becomes a rejecting repeated map option.

fields.name: structured
fields.type: Projected outputSchema, or option<string> carrying undeclared structured JSON text

nativeMetadata.annotations: Map MCP readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, and openWorldHint with MCP defaults.

successfulResult.structured: Validate structuredContent against declared outputSchema. If no outputSchema was declared, preserve present structuredContent as JSON text in option<string>.

content.none: Empty MCP content array; no stdout.
content.streamed: Exactly one text, image, or audio block; bytes move to finite native stdout and metadata retains MIME, annotations, and extensions.
content.blocks: Multiple or non-streamable blocks remain typed values: text, image, audio, resource-link, or embedded text/blob resource, including annotations and extensions.

errors.mcpIsError: Collapse MCP error content to the declared mcp-tool-error string payload.
errors.unknownOrMalformedContent: Produce invalid-result; do not silently drop unknown content types, malformed base64, or malformed embedded resources.

unsupportedJsonSchema: multi-type unions that cannot be represented by the native schema projection

roundTripExpectations.metadataTarget: The MCP-projected native metadata above, not CONTRACT-1 native metadata.
preserved: projectable JSON input and structured output schemas
finite text/binary stdout and stderr content with channel metadata on export
custom error name and payload as MCP error text
MCP content blocks and annotations/extensions on import
notPreserved: native command hierarchy as hierarchy; it becomes one MCP tool per executable canonical/alias path
native executable constraint metadata; it is descriptive text plus server-side validation
native error kind and exit code
live stream identity and chunk boundaries
identityBoundaries: The exporting environment owns and invokes the native tool.
The importing environment owns the projected MCP tool invocation; original agent identity does not cross MCP.
